Subject: Renewal discussion — looking to increase commit, discuss price/credits

Hi Priya,

Hope youre well. Our current contract with Redwood comes up for renewal in January and were forecasting a 2.5x increase in token consumption next year based on product roadmap. Were interested in moving to a larger committed tier in exchange for a deeper discount or a price hold.

Attached is our Q3 usage report and the SOC2 summary your compliance team asked for. High-level asks from Deftly: 
- A price hold for the first 12 months after renewal (we need predictable unit economics for our budgeting cycle)
- A mechanism for unused commit credits to roll or convert into credits for burst months
- Clarification on dedicated capacity pricing if we lock a minimum pool

Can we schedule 30 minutes this week to sketch out options? Procurement is copied on this thread.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Chen

Deftly, Inc.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>

Subject: Mutual action plan + two pricing options (draft)

Hi all,

Thanks for the productive call. Attached below is a short MAP and two concrete options for Deftly to consider. Please review and flag any legal or procurement items you want explicitly called out. Ill update the MAP after we have procurements confirmation on the PO language.

Option A — 12-month renewal (fastest close):
- Commit: 2.5x current committed tokens
- Discount: 15% off current list generation pricing for the first 12 months
- Price hold: 12 months
- Bridge credit: one-time $25,000 credit applied in month 1 to smooth consumption spikes
- Unused commit: credits roll for up to 3 months for burst months only (no cash refunds)
- Dedicated capacity: optional; add-on priced separately with 30-day SLA onboarding

Option B — 24-month renewal (term-backed pricing):
- Commit: 2.5x current committed tokens
- Discount: 20% off current list generation pricing year-over-year
- Price hold: first 12 months guaranteed at the discounted rate; year 2 pricing adjustable with 60-day notice
- Bridge credit: one-time $45,000 credit applied in Q1
- Unused commit: credits rollover up to 6 months; limited convert-to-burst usage
- Dedicated capacity: included as a reserved pool at a preferred rate (subject to capacity planning)

Next steps:
1) Procurement to confirm PO language on price hold and unused credits
2) Legal to confirm liability language for dedicated capacity
3) Decide option A or B and well issue a term sheet and DocuSign envelope (I can draft it once we have a selection)

Timing note: to meet your Nov finance gate wed need a signed term sheet by 2027-11-10.

Cheers,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
